headline: dancers on a glowing vintage CRT screen in a dark room at night

entities.name: vintage CRT television
entities.description: boxy cathode-ray tube set with a rounded, slightly convex glass screen recessed behind a thick bezel; dark grey-brown plastic housing with a moulded inner frame and softly rounded corners, dust-dulled surface catching a faint sheen along the top edge; the picture fills the tube with heavy static speckle, horizontal scanline banding and a bright halation bloom near the centre

entities.name: central dancing man
entities.description: slim young man, short cropped dark hair, in a dark long-sleeved shirt and dark narrow trousers with pale shoes; body turned three-quarters, one knee bent forward, arms bent close to the torso, head tipped down and slightly to one side; rendered in cold monochrome with a bright rim of light along his shoulders and back

entities.name: dancer in patterned dress at left
entities.description: woman with long dark hair, wearing a short light-toned patterned dress and low boots, one arm raised with elbow bent, hips angled away from camera, silhouette edged in white glare

entities.name: dancer in dark shirt left of centre
entities.description: figure in an untucked dark shirt and dark trousers, both fists raised near chest height, one leg lifted mid-step, face lost to the bright backlight

entities.name: dancer with curly hair right of centre
entities.description: person with a full halo of curly hair, light sleeveless top and pale shorts or short skirt, arms outstretched sideways, one heel kicked back

entities.name: dancer at far right
entities.description: figure in a light patterned top and dark trousers, arms bent and lifted, turned partly away, mostly a bright-edged silhouette against the glowing wall

entities.name: further dancers in the haze
entities.description: two or three additional indistinct bodies deeper in the room, reduced to grey shapes and pale limb streaks in the smoke and static

action: a group of people dance in a smoke-filled room, replayed on the screen of an old television standing in an unlit space
location: a dark room with a switched-on CRT television
locationDescription: foreground: near-black surroundings with only the faint edge of the television's plastic casing catching light, the set filling most of the frame; mid-ground: the rounded glass screen, its picture curving at the corners, speckled with dense white static; inside the picture a room with a smooth curved wall and pale floor, banks of light blasting from behind the dancers to bleach the far wall into a white glare, thick haze in the air scattering the beams; the room's edges fall off into grey murk on both sides
era: vintage — mid-twentieth-century television set, dancers styled in an earlier decade
angle: eye level, square-on to the screen, slightly centred on the tube
lightingSources: hard backlight banks inside the televised scene bleaching the rear wall
scattered bloom through the haze in the picture
weak spill from the screen grazing the plastic bezel
contrast: very high — bright screen against near-black room, crushed blacks
opticsEffect: the screen's picture holds soft, slightly smeared detail while the dark casing and surrounding room fall away into featureless black; the glass curvature stretches the image at the corners
medium: photograph of a television screen, analogue video texture
atmosphere: dust and smoke hang visibly in the backlight, static crawls across the glass, limbs frozen mid-step with bright edges, the surrounding room swallowed in dark
